# London Trading Institute

> London Trading Institute (LTI) is a London-based trading education provider offering courses, one-to-one mentorship and systematic/automated trading programmes across forex, cryptocurrency and options. LTI is led by Andy Demi and the LTI strategy development team.

London Trading Institute helps individuals learn to trade professionally through structured education, mentorship and a systematic approach built on testing, evidence and risk management. LTI emphasises backtesting, forward testing and disciplined risk management rather than guesswork.

Contact: info@londontradinginstitute.com · +44 20 3887 7398 · London, United Kingdom · https://www.londontradinginstitute.com

## Courses and programmes

- [Auto Strategy Club](https://www.londontradinginstitute.com/auto-strategy-club): Build, test and automate trading strategies without coding. A practical environment where non-programmers can turn trading ideas into clear rules, backtest them against historical data, forward test, manage risk and — when appropriate — automate execution from TradingView to MT4/MT5.
- [Elite Trader Programme (one-to-one)](https://www.londontradinginstitute.com/elite-trader-programme): One-to-one trading mentorship with the LTI team for traders who want personalised guidance.
- [Free Introductory Course](https://www.londontradinginstitute.com/intro-forex-course): A free introduction to trading and the LTI approach for beginners.
- [Associate Trader Programme](https://www.londontradinginstitute.com/associate-trader-programme): A structured programme covering the core skills required to trade the markets professionally.
- [Advanced Forex Course](https://www.londontradinginstitute.com/advanced-forex): An advanced forex course for traders building on the fundamentals.
- [Options Trading Course](https://www.londontradinginstitute.com/options): Learn options theory and how to build trading strategies for different market conditions.
- [Crypto Like A Pro Investing](https://www.londontradinginstitute.com/crypto-like-a-pro): How to build a passive cryptocurrency portfolio.
- [Crypto Like A Pro Trading System](https://www.londontradinginstitute.com/crypto-like-a-pro-system): Learn to trade cryptocurrency using LTI's systematic strategies.

## Tools and resources

- [Pro FX Indicators](https://www.londontradinginstitute.com/indicators): Free trials of LTI's Pro FX indicators — Daily Trading Range, Auto Fibonacci, Supply & Demand zones, automatic trend lines and a position risk manager.
- [Events](https://www.londontradinginstitute.com/events): Live trading events and webinars.

## Notes

- Trading involves risk. London Trading Institute provides education and is not a substitute for regulated financial advice.
- Automation does not remove trading risk and does not guarantee a strategy will be profitable.
